PRIVACY NOTICE

Your demo activity stays on your device.

Effective October 1, 2026. NestMatch is a public portfolio demo and does not require an account.

Information saved locally

The site uses browser storage to remember your role, preferences, decisions, matches, profile text, and compressed photos. This information remains in the browser you use and is not uploaded to a NestMatch server or shared with other visitors.

Referral links

The share control creates a link with standard campaign labels so a future privacy-respecting analytics setup can distinguish invited visits. This version does not send those labels to a NestMatch analytics service.

Advertising and cookies

NestMatch does not currently run third-party advertising or ad-personalization cookies. This notice will be updated before advertising or external analytics are activated.

Your choices

Use “Reset demo” to clear matching activity and the profile editor’s “Clear profile” control to remove profile information. Clearing this site’s browser storage also removes all locally saved demo data.
